critical_code_review_comments: RoomView.js is 1102 lines — exceeds the 700-line soft limit. Consider splitting header toolbar + panels into separate components for maintainability (HeaderToolbar.js, SecondRow.js).

The TOP TOOLBAR (lines 862-912) and the bottom panel dispatch use setPanel('tienda'|'games'|'cofres'|'sobres'|'gifts-all') — string literals duplicated across 6 call sites. Extract into a PANEL_IDS constant to prevent typos.

Agora RTC voice chat is still emitting repeated 'CAN_NOT_GET_GATEWAY_SERVER: invalid token, authorized failed' errors on room entry (observed ~7 failures per entry). Not related to this iteration but pre-existing — token minting endpoint likely missing valid App Certificate or has expired. Flag for main agent review when voice chat is revisited.
3x '404 Failed to load resource' errors on every page load (non-blocking). Likely missing favicon or a static asset referenced by index.html — worth investigating and silencing.
